description.narrative:
Planning phase for cooperation with the Ministry of Gender Equality in Uganda The goal for this phase is at the output level, namely that Bufdir and the Ministry of Gender Equality prepare a programme document that will serve as an application to enter into an agreement with Norad on country programme cooperation from 2023. The Norwegian Ministry of Culture and Statistics Norway will assist in this process.
The focus will be to find a starting point for cooperation and getting to know each other. Below is a tentative work plan for the inception phase. Objectives for the inception phase • Develop a defined relationship with team Uganda o Establish the core teams and decide on communication platforms and expectations o Develop a roadmap for the inceptions phase o Establish the Reference Group of Expert and define their role in the program • Conduct a workshop on gender and statistics o Conduct a digital pre-workshop on gender and statistics with relevant actors o Conduct a workshop with SSB, KUD, UBOS and MGLSD on gender and statistics o Evaluate the workshop and decide for the steps forward. • Establish a relationship to other actors on gender equality or institutions in Uganda o Learn about what they do, to avoid duplicating efforts o Create possible synergies cross programmes/efforts • Organize a mission to Norway for Uganda o Develop a program for the participants to ? Learn about Norwegian work on gender equality ? Follow up the GEfD-programme in Uganda e.g. organizing workshops • Evaluate and check-in with the end goal of defining a programme document for 2023-2025
